name: spirula-studio
description: Cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer - video to splat to mesh, Vulkan or CUDA.
one_liner: An app that turns a phone video walking through a room or building into a realistic, explorable 3D scan — no film crew or special camera needed.
buyer: A real-estate agent or small architecture firm that wants immersive 3D walkthroughs of listings or renovation projects without hiring a specialized photogrammetry studio.
business_use_cases: A real-estate agent films a walkthrough on their phone and delivers a 3D virtual tour to sellers as a premium listing add-on.
A small museum or heritage site scans a room or artifact for a permanent interactive online exhibit.
An indie game or VR studio captures real-world reference scenes cheaply for use as game assets instead of commissioning custom 3D art.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a local 'walkthrough scanning' service to real-estate agents: film it, process it, deliver the 3D tour.
Sell a subscription scanning service to small real-estate brokerages who want this for every listing.

steal_this: Scan a local business's storefront or a friend's apartment listing this weekend and pitch real-estate agents on a paid '3D tour for your listing' add-on using the free web viewer as the demo.
